<!-- pr-reviewer: 06dfbcaafab3e6bc98fd2cbed85c9ee884bbfd2c -->
Needs changes before merge.

The guide gives the work offset, index angles, tool changes, and checks. It states that the stock simulation did not judge the cuts. The continuous workflow stays open in #1904. This PR does not change `crates/ui`; the UI screenshot rule does not apply.

Local checks passed after a trial merge with upstream main `57f2ffbb`:

- Rust build: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_4axis_part --no-run`.
- Rust tests: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_4axis_part`: 3 passed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Site tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 36 passed.
- Site build: Zola built 44 pages with no error.

Safety checks: I read all 140 NC lines. Each of the five index moves follows `G53 G0 Z0`. No cutting line has an A word. The four flats have the same cutting lines. The cross slot ends at Z0.345. The Rust tests confirm that both the saved project and the command-built project post the saved NC file.

I ran two fixture mutations with temporary copies of the NC file. I did not change the PR files:

- Remove the Z retract before A90: the inline G-code test failed. The original file passed.
- Change A90 to A45: the operation table test failed. The original file passed.

Requested before merge:

1. `examples/models/gen_first_4axis_part_obj.py:33`: Make the model match the cut. The model has a full flat section from X-0.875 to X-0.125. The 0.25 in tool moves from X-0.75 to X-0.25, so its cut has round ends. For example, the committed model has a top surface at Z0.360 at X-0.87, Y0.05 in. This point is 0.130 in from the nearest tool centre, beyond the 0.125 in tool radius. The tool does not cut this point. The round bar remains about Z0.37165 there, about 0.01165 in above the model. Change the model to include the round ends, or change the operations to make the model. Update the model stored in the project. Add a test that compares the cut shape with the model at the ends of each flat; the current tests check file agreement but miss this error.

Notes: No PathPilot Hub run, air cut, or machine cut was done in this review. The PR states these limits. Keep those checks open on #1904.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review fix for the comment on `06dfbcaaf`. The new head is `7c960e97e61c4ba72f2399c521ab77a0a79664f3`. The PR stays a draft. The branch has no merge of `main`.

**Finding 1: the model did not match the cut at the ends of each flat.**

- Fix: `examples/models/gen_first_4axis_part_obj.py` now makes each flat with the round ends that the 0.25 in tool cuts. The flat reaches X-0.875 and X-0.125 on its centre line only. `examples/models/first-4axis-part.obj` and the model in `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj` are made again. The operations and `examples/first-4axis-part.nc` did not change.
- Test: `the_model_is_the_bar_as_the_program_cuts_it` in `crates/app/tests/first_4axis_part.rs`.
  - It loads the committed project and reads the cached toolpath of each operation.
  - On each of the four faces it compares the model surface with the surface that the cuts leave: the bar skin, or the tool tip where a cutting move covers the point. The grid has 0.0125 in steps, from X-1.0 to X0 and 0.2 in to each side. The tolerance is 0.02 mm. Points nearer than 0.05 mm to a wall are not compared.
  - It also checks the point of the review: at X-0.87, 0.05 in from the centre line, the model is at 0.37165 in.
  - It checks that the project holds the same number of facets as the `.obj` file.
- Red before the fix: with the old model the test failed with "face [0.0, 0.0, 1.0] at X-0.8625 in, -0.1000 in off the centre line: the model is at 0.36000 in, the cut leaves 0.36142 in".
- The page now says that each flat has round ends. `docs/decisions/1904-first-4axis-part.md` records the correction.

**Gates on the new head**

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green (`first_4axis_part`, 4 tests).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test first_4axis_part -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 36 tests, OK.
- `zola build`: 44 pages, no error.
- `camcraft-cli process examples/first-4axis-part.camproj` writes the committed program, byte for byte.

**Not exercised:** PathPilot Hub run, air cut, machine cut, GUI click-through. These stay open on #1904.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7c960e97e61c4ba72f2399c521ab77a0a79664f3 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier finding on `06dfbcaaf` is resolved. The model now has the round ends that the tool cuts. The project and the OBJ contain the same 3,516 triangles, with the same coordinates. At X-0.87, Y0.05 in, the OBJ surface is Z0.37164855 in. The bar skin is Z0.37165172 in. The error is 0.000081 mm. The old model had an error of 0.295954 mm at this point. The new Rust test compares the model with the saved cutting moves on all four faces.

Local checks passed after a trial merge with upstream main `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41`:

- Build: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_4axis_part --no-run`.
- Rust tests: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test first_4axis_part`: 4 passed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Site tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 36 passed with Zola 0.23.6.
- Site build: Zola 0.23.6 built 44 pages with no error.
- Gate plan: the quick gate selects `first_4axis_part`, which passed above.

The first site test run could not find Zola. I downloaded Zola 0.23.6 into `/tmp` and ran the suite again. No GitHub runner was used.

Safety review: I read all 140 NC lines. The five index moves follow `G53 G0 Z0`. No cutting line has an A word. The four flats have the same cutting lines. The cross slot ends at Z0.345. The NC file is unchanged from the earlier head. Both saved-project posting and command-built posting match it byte for byte.

I repeated two mutations with temporary NC copies:

- Remove the retract before A90: the inline G-code test failed. The original file passed.
- Change A90 to A45: the operation index test failed. The original file passed.

Requested before merge: none. This review clears the earlier request to correct the model and add a shape test.

Notes: This PR changes no `crates/ui` code, so the UI screenshot rule does not apply. No PathPilot Hub run, air cut, machine cut or GUI click-through was done. The PR states these limits. The images and the remaining simulator and continuous-work checks stay open under #1904. The guide states that stock simulation did not judge the indexed cuts.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: No outstanding findings in the latest review on current head 7c960e97e61c4ba72f2399c521ab77a0a79664f3.

The latest review explicitly says "Requested before merge: none" and clears the earlier model-shape finding. It cites the_model_is_the_bar_as_the_program_cuts_it, four passing first_4axis_part tests, and passing clippy as evidence.

No files changed. No new commit or push. No gate or mutation checks were rerun because there is no requested fix. The PR's ready status and labels are unchanged.

Please re-review this unchanged head if any findings remain.
